nodes.statement: On nonzero ambient vectors the Rayleigh quotient is scaling invariant; on the unit sphere it is the literal quadratic F(x)=xᵀAx. The chosen all-space extension is quadratic, not the ambient quotient with an off-domain fallback.
Real finite Euclidean space and symmetric matrix/linear operator with standard Euclidean inner product.

nodes.anchor: Example3.36 difference-quotient display and Example3.62 first derivative display
nodes.statement: Symmetry combines the two product contributions into Dq(x)[v]=2⟨Ax,v⟩. The genuine derivative is proved; it is not an assumed certificate.
Nondegenerate Euclidean pairing identifies the actual ambient gradient as2Ax.
Choose the sphere metric inherited from E; chart norm is not silently substituted for it.
T_xS is x perpendicular; actual intrinsic directions are compared through inclusion, with all tangent directions represented.
For any ambient u the tangent projection is u−⟨x,u⟩x since x is unit. Unit normalization is essential and discharged by sphere membership.
Under the induced metric, the actual restricted differential has gradient represented by the projection of the ambient gradient.

nodes.anchor: Def3.58 characterization/Exercise3.64 used by projection recipe
nodes.statement: Positive inherited inner product uniquely determines a tangent representative from all differential pairings; parent sphere characterization supplies this selected interface.
Substitute2Ax into the true tangent projection to obtain2(Ax−⟨x,Ax⟩x).
The coefficient2 is nonzero, so vanishing of the induced gradient is equivalent to Ax=⟨x,Ax⟩x. Zero differential has the same meaning through the actual metric pairing.
A stationary unit point is nonzero and is an eigenvector with real eigenvalue⟨x,Ax⟩.
For a unit eigenvector Ax=μx, pairing with x gives μ=⟨x,Ax⟩; substituting makes the gradient and genuine sphere differential vanish.

The literal quadratic q(y)=⟨y,Ay⟩ is a smooth ambient extension of F on the sphere. This is a derived standing source context from linearity/inner product, not a public smoothness binder or supplied derivative certificate. The sealed targets only need its genuine pointwise differential.

nodes.anchor: Definition3.58 all-tangent characterization with positive induced inner product, §§3.7–3.8; adapter used at Example3.62 critical-point display
nodes.statement: For the genuine sphere differential and induced pairing, D F(x)=0 iff the uniquely characterized induced tangent representative is zero. Test all tangent directions and use nondegeneracy; abstract chart tests cover the ambient tangent plane through actual inclusion. This explicitly expands the source grad=0 condition into the sealed actual mvfderiv=0 condition; it is a source-derived formalization adapter, not literal printed Example3.62 prose.
